decision.reason: The release-note section [ev-963b8a5003cf] covers several separate changes at once: PolicyException and CleanupPolicy graduating to v2, and four deprecated policy-level fields (spec.validationFailureAction, spec.validationFailureActionOverrides, spec.mutateExistingOnPolicyUpdate, spec.generateExisting), each with its own replacement. The excerpt is also cut off partway through the replacement list. The rendered diffs show the new per-rule fields being added ([ev-236984661abb], [ev-af63781cf017], [ev-4c73e901708e], [ev-d4e55a3c3ecb]) and v2beta1/v1beta1 CRD versions marked deprecated ([ev-0cc54c6e1585], [ev-08e1559e3c95], [ev-c2e6033ce1d5]), but none of them shows the old spec-level fields being deprecated. The only consequence stated is removal "in a future release", with nothing on what happens in 1.13 itself. Writing one typed assertion needs this item split into one change per deprecated field or CRD version, plus the full, untruncated replacement mapping and the removal timing.
